03-0077.name: Sun Country Airlines
03-0077.detail: Allegiant acquired Sun Country for about USD 1.5bn; transaction closed 13 May 2026; revenue about USD 1.1bn in 2025

14-0148.name: Beazley
14-0148.detail: Zurich's agreed GBP 8.1bn takeover was court-approved on 22 Sept 2026; Beazley was LSE-listed until acquired in September 2026; revenue USD 6.06bn in 2025

48-0677.name: Semrush
48-0677.detail: Adobe completed its USD 1.9bn acquisition of Semrush on 28 April 2026; revenue USD 443.6m in 2025

46-0010.name: Clearwater Analytics
46-0010.pe: GT Silver BidCo (Permira and Warburg Pincus-led investor group)
46-0010.detail: Take-private by a Permira and Warburg Pincus-led investor group for about USD 8.4bn (USD 24.55 per share); completed 25 June 2026

37-0005.name: Integer Holdings
37-0005.detail: KKR completed its USD 5.7bn acquisition of Integer on 19 Nov 2026; the shares no longer trade

26-0312.name: LXP Industrial Trust
26-0312.detail: Brookfield and CPP Investments completed the USD 5.2bn acquisition of LXP Industrial Trust on 7 Nov 2026

32-0356.name: Utz Brands
32-0356.detail: Intersnack completed its USD 2.9bn acquisition of Utz Brands (reported 23 Nov 2026)

22-0049.name: Irish Continental Group
22-0049.detail: Management buyout at EUR 1.2bn (about USD 1.32bn) completed; the Dublin and London listings were due to be cancelled on 23 Nov 2026

25-0176.name: Arcosa
25-0176.detail: CRH completed its USD 8.5bn acquisition of Arcosa on 26 Oct 2026
